client_review: Frog and chick: no usable photo (only small partial views in img-009, img-024, img-017). Ask client for clear photos before listing them.

Octopus: the white octopus (img-017) and yellow octopus (img-024) are hand held crops with busy backgrounds. Red and green octopus only appear in the group image img-009, so ask for single clean photos of red, green, yellow and white octopuses.
Octopus multicolour: img-006 shows pastel, bright rainbow and speckled variegated octopuses. Ask whether these are separate colourways (pastel, bright, speckled) and for single photos.

Shark: five colours exist (yellow, pink, green, purple grey, dark grey) but only one group photo (img-028). Every shark colourway reuses it. Request single shots per colour. Confirm the two grey purple tones are separate colourways.
Butterfly: four colourways found (blue, cream and pink, red, mint green and yellow), not two. Confirm. Red butterfly (img-023) is 'red' with variegated pink grey wings.

Goose: vote decisions say goose (img-077 cream, img-081 white with pale yellow wings); many people would call these ducks. Client to confirm goose or duck and whether cream and white-pale-yellow are the same design.
Turtle: img-084 shows three colourways but only mint and cream is fully visible; pink and blue turtles are cut off. Request clean photos. Green turtle also appears in stalls without a usable photo.

Chameleon (img-036) and dinosaur (img-032): both photos have a studio look and the dinosaur resembles a well known video game character. Confirm Mikono made these and that they are Mikono photos, and rights for character likeness.
Sizes: shownSize left null everywhere. Octopus and chick appear S in displays but is unconfirmed.

People images: img-006 (two women at stall, faces visible), img-007 (stall, partial person), hand in img-017 and img-024. Suggested captions: 'Makers at a beach craft market with crocheted lions and octopuses' and 'Octopuses on a market table'.
